topic: DoorRL3LampBrthngCmd_1 (Door Right Rear Lamp Breathing Command 1)
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific breathing rate command for the door right rear lamp, defined by a hexadecimal code value.

column_semantics.Code Value: The hexadecimal command code that specifies the breathing rate.
column_semantics.Period: The time period (in seconds) for one complete breathing cycle.
column_semantics.Original Breathing Mode Value: The corresponding original breathing mode associated with the rate.

core_entities.name: DoorRL3LampBrthngCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command for controlling the breathing pattern of the right rear door lamp.

core_entities.name: LHZCU_LIN4
core_entities.description: Local Zone Control Unit connected via LIN4 bus, responsible for processing and executing the breathing command.

core_entities.name: DoorAmbtLampC_RL
core_entities.description: Door Ambient Lamp Controller for the right side, which receives commands from LHZCU.

core_entities.name: LIN
core_entities.description: Local Interconnect Network communication interface used to send commands to the LHZCU.

core_conditions.name: Code Value
core_conditions.description: Specifies the breathing rate command using hexadecimal values from 0x0 to 0xF.

core_conditions.name: Period
core_conditions.description: Defines the duration of one breathing cycle, ranging from 'No Request' to 12 seconds.

core_outputs.name: Breathing Mode
core_outputs.description: The resulting breathing pattern of the lamp, which can be a new mode or an original mode depending on the rate.

core_timing_constraints.name: Period
core_timing_constraints.description: Defines the timing for each breathing cycle, e.g., 500ms, 1s, up to 12s.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the mapping between hexadecimal command codes and their corresponding breathing rates for the door right rear lamp. It is used to verify that the lamp responds correctly to different breathing commands sent via LIN communication to the LHZCU, which then controls the DoorAmbtLampC_RL module.
